Name: Lani - Custom NPC for Sunberry Village
Author: atelier99
Description:
[center]﻿[img]https://i.imgur.com/PV1rmWZ.png[/img][/center][size=4]Lani is a laid-back, socially awkward chatterbox who can't stop rambling once you get her started. Video games and internet happenings are her lifeblood; you'll usually find her embroiled in a game on her Bintendo Switch, or playing on her gaming PC.

Underneath the sarcastic quips, old online references and embarrassing stories is a woman who just wishes to get her creative spark back.

[i][quote]After failing to get a start in the game art industry 3 years prior, Pine Mesa native Lani moved to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry[/url]﻿ for a 'change in scenery'. The artist-turned-IT-technician decided to get a job in the burgeoning tech field instead of pursuing her creative endeavors. A relatable story featuring the tales of struggling with life fulfillment, burnout, and learning to let go of the past.[/quote][/i]
Compatible with all major ﻿expansions (SVE, RSV, ES, VMV, etc!)

[b]This mod includes[/b]: randomized dialogue, a config for "modern" or "older" references, seasonal outfits, 2/4/6/8/10 heart events, crossover events with Sunberry Village and Pelican Town residents, quests, special orders, and new items!
[/size]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/mCVQ84z.png[/img][/center][size=4][b]Vanilla Gift Tastes[/b]
[spoiler][b]Loves[/b]: Sunflower, Summer Spangle, Battery Pack, Maki Roll, Sashimi, Fried Calamari, Opal, Fire Opal, anything tagged  "color_yellow", anything tagged "soju_item"
[b]Likes[/b]: Rainbow Shell, Duck Feather, Salmon, Beer, Salmon Dinner, any alcohol item
[b]Neutrals[/b]: Mayonnaise, Pale Ale
[b]Dislikes[/b]: Coffee
[b]Hates[/b]: Jelly, Pickles, Caviar, Roe, Aged Roe, any jelly item, any pickle item[/spoiler][/size]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/LtjilXj.png[/img][/center][size=4]During the spring and fall, Lani is at work from 6:00AM to 1:30PM. After that, you can find her around Sunberry Village! In winter and summer, you can see her more often around Sunberry and Pelican Town. Check out various locations around Sunberry to find her! Detailed schedule is below the spoiler.
[spoiler][b]Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday, Friday[/b]: Goes to work at 7:00AM, in her house after 1:30PM
[b]Thursday[/b]: After work, hangs out around the river before arriving at Haley's house at 4:30PM, starts walking home at 8:30PM
[b]Saturday[/b]: At Jonghyuk's house at 7:30, gardening in Sunberry at 9:00AM, attends the Sunberry Hangout from 12:30PM onwards
[b]Sunday[/b]: Gardening at 9:30AM, in Ari's Market at 11:00AM, returns home at 3:00PM
[b](Summer) Monday[/b]: Goes to Sunberry Library at 10:00AM, returns home at 5:00PM
[b](Summer) Tuesday[/b]: Goes to the Beach at 10:00AM, goes to work for Pierre at 12:50PM, returns home at 5:00PM
[b](Summer) Wednesday[/b]: In her house all day
[b](Summer) Thursday[/b]: At the bathhouse at 6:00AM, goes to Town at 1:30PM, returns home at 5:00PM
[b](Summer) Saturday[/b]: Attending the Sunberry Hangout
[b](Winter) Tuesday[/b]: Goes to Ari's Market at 9:30AM, returns home at 3:00PM
[b]Winter 15[/b]: At the bathhouse all day until 5:30PM, when she goes to Maru's house to spend the night
[b]Winter 16[/b]: At Maru's house, goes to the Night Market at 3:40PM with Maru and Sebastian [/spoiler][/size]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/lO6E6b0.png[/img][/center][size=4][b]Main Story Events [/b]
[spoiler][b]2 Hearts[/b]: Enter Lani's house between 9:00AM and 3:00PM on a Sunday.
Event Details: [spoiler]"Open Wounds" features Lani discussing her past and present relationship with art.[/spoiler]
[b]4 Hearts[/b]: Enter your farmhouse.
Event Details: [spoiler]"Kyoufuu All Back", titled after [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xUYZ6ViKFh8]the Vocaloid song[/url] has Lani phoning the farmer and asking if they're happy with their life.[/spoiler]
[b]6 Hearts[/b]: Enter Lani's house.
Event Details: [spoiler]"The Desire to Create" is where the farmer convinces Lani to try other forms of art to see if it reignites her spark.[/spoiler]
[b]Part 2[/b]: Enter Serenity Inn in Sunberry Village.
Event Details: [spoiler]"Painting with Lyenne" has Lani trying out acrylic paints with Lyenne.[/spoiler]
[b]Part 3[/b]: Enter Leah's house after seeing Part 2.
Event Details: [spoiler]"Ceramics with Leah" has Lani trying out clay sculpting with Leah.[/spoiler]
[b]Part 4[/b]: Enter Robin's house after seeing Part 3.
Event Details: [spoiler]"Woodworking with Robin" has Lani trying out woodworking with Robin and Maru.[/spoiler]
[b]8 Hearts[/b]: See the 6 Heart event and check your mail.
Event Details: [spoiler]"Marginal", titled after [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xOAoZTDWqlc]this Vocaloid song[/url], is a letter Lani writes to the player about her finally trying to enjoy the creative process again.[/spoiler]
[b]10 Hearts[/b]: Enter Lani's house.
Event Details: [spoiler]"world end BREAK!", titled after [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=VK9lh8HFz9w]this Vocaloid song[/url], is a short cinematic where Lani finally sits down and feels inspired enough to draw for the first time in years.[/spoiler]
[/spoiler]
[b]Side Events[/b]
[spoiler][b]Sam, Sebastian[/b]: Enter the Saloon NOT on a Friday from 5:30PM to 9:00PM
Event Details: [spoiler]"The Perfect Video Game" has Sam, Sebastian and Lani debating on what matters most in a video game. A shocking answer comes from an unexpected place.[/spoiler]
[b]Sterling[/b]: Get Lani to 2 hearts and enter Sunberry Village between 6:00AM and 5:00PM.
Event Details: [spoiler]"The Kindling Match" dives briefly into the shared dating history of Sterling and Lani.[/spoiler]
[b]Pierre[/b]: Get Lani to 4 hearts and enter Pierre's General Store.
Event Details: [spoiler]"Pierre's Secret Admirer" shows the farmer running into Lani doing a little... spying.[/spoiler]
[/spoiler][/size]


[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/USTtVa8.png[/img][/center][center][size=4]Lani has more content coming soon!
[s] A custom companion of Lani's cat, Sammy! Will be introduced in version 1.1.[/s]
More crossover events with other NPCs, including [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32660]Ripley[/url]﻿, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32385]The Alchemist,[/url]﻿ [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12000]Jonghyuk[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6307]Lucikiel[/url]﻿!
Possibly a potential romance on the horizon..?![/size][/center]
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/AZHBeeE.png[/img][/center][center][size=4]This mod is compatible with everything [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11111]Sunberry Village[/url]﻿ is compatible with!
There is some [b]cross-mod content[/b] for the following:
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/25574]Fresh and Bit - New Recipes[/url]﻿ - Custom gift tastes
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/26650]Culinary Delight[/url]﻿ - Custom gift tastes
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19508]Cornucopia (+ add-ons)[/url]﻿ - Custom gift tastes, 1+ special order
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/27049]Wildflour Atelier Goods[/url]﻿ (WAG) - Custom gift tastes
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3753]Stardew Valley Expanded[/url]﻿ (SVE) - Custom gift tastes
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12000]Jonghyuk[/url]﻿ - Events, dialogue, more future content[/size][/center]

[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/Euy6sof.png[/img]
[size=5][b]Translators, please ask before starting a translation![/b][/size][/center]

[list]

[/list][/left]
[size=4][center]If you have any questions about any text or words used in this mod, please send me a message either on Nexus or on Discord [i](@atel2er)[/i]! ﻿﻿[/center][/size]
